Issue: User wants to transfer another character to a different server.
Resolution: Explained that the voucher is limited to one per account, but that it will be possible to purchase additional vouchers soon.

Issue: The user cannot upgrade a specific item.
Resolution: Provided the user with workarounds.

Issue: Player reported frustration with bots and cheaters affecting gameplay.
Resolution: Acknowledged concerns, confirmed daily bans and system improvements, and thanked player for their fair play and reports.

Issue: False positive restriction triggered by anti-bot system
Resolution: Clarified that the restriction was an anti-bot error. Also informed the user our team is focused on reducing false positives.

Issue: Player submitted feedback regarding game features or experience.
Resolution: Acknowledged feedback and recommended posting in Discord #game-suggestions for direct CM review.

Issue: Player reported another user for suspected policy violations.
Resolution: Directed the player to use the in-game "Report" button for immediate processing.

Issue: User reported restrictions on Market or Exchange access due to their account's trust status.
Resolution: Explained the Trust Status System, potential factors affecting trust status, and that accounts may be reviewed for reinstatement.

Issue: Player submitted feedback regarding game features or experience.
Resolution: Acknowledged feedback and recommended posting in Discord #bugs-report for direct CM review.

Issue: User claimed to have lost items from Server Storage.
Resolution: User forgot to retrieve items from Server Storage before transferring to another server, and they were left behind.

This transformation may occur after failing the CAPTCHA one or more times at specific points following repetitive in-game activities.

Although this system is designed to help detect and prevent bot activity, false positives can still occur, and legitimate players may occasionally be affected. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.

Our team is working hard to improve the efficiency of the anti-bot system while reducing the occurrence of false positives. Significant improvements have already been made, and we remain committed to making the system more accurate and reliable for legitimate players.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue working to improve your gameplay experience.

Resolution: Explained CAPTCHA triggers, acknowledged possible false positives, and confirmed ongoing improvements to system accuracy and false positive reduction.

Issue: User lost Genus Insight.
Resolution: The user had the option to choose which Genus Insight to import to the new server, but selected the wrong one.
